svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.13k stars in total, about 1.74k a year earlier. jactionlint 308, mr boxington 671, aube 2061, fnox 2353, hk 1297, pitchfork 703, usage 1068, +5 more 673.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
